collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DISABILITY AND HUMAN DIVERSITY (DIV-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Disabled villagers, chronic illness and every kind of body, skin, hair and face: wheelchairs with real wheels, crutches, canes, ear trumpets, signs and lenses made from island materials; good days and hard days; competence, humor and opinions. Sometimes the difference is the story. Often it's just part of the scenery.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an elder and a builder or another adult; in the story (name1) walks with a frame)

collection.description: An elder complains all morning about the new walking frame: ask what would make it better, or let them grumble.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has started walking with a frame: a light square of bamboo with four feet that (subject.he/she) lifts and sets down ahead of (subject.him/her). (friend) built it, and it works very well. (subject), however, has been complaining about it all morning. It's ugly, it's slow, it makes (subject.him/her) feel old. (friend) is starting to wonder if (friend.he/she) should have built it at all.

choices.label: Ask What Would Make It Better

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Too ugly?" says (friend). "Then let's fix that." (subject) is caught off guard. They spend the afternoon on it: carved handles, a little basket hung on the front for carrying things, a bright red cord wrapped round the top. (subject) takes it for a walk. Then another. By evening (subject.he/she) has named it. (subject.He/she) refuses to say what (subject.he/she) named it.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) leaves (subject.him/her) to grumble. (subject) grumbles all week. But (subject.he/she) also walks to the stream, the gardens and the far end of the beach, places (subject.he/she) hadn't been in a long time. At the end of the week (subject.he/she) tells (friend) the frame is still ugly. Then (subject.he/she) asks (friend) to make a second one for inside the hut.
